t:
There is appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for an additional amount for “Construction of an Extension to the New Senate Office Building” $52,583,400 toward finishing such building and to remain available until expended: Provided, That the amount of $137,730,400 shall constitute a ceiling on the total cost for construction of the Extension to the New Senate Office Building.
It is further provided that such building and office space therein upon completion shall meet all needs for personnel presently sup-plied by the Carroll Arms, the Senate Courts, the Plaza Hotel, the Capitol Hill Apartments and such buildings shall be vacated.

This Act may be cited as the “Energy and Water Development Appropriation Act, 1980”.

fable.w: This section only appropriates funds for a Senate office building extension, sets a cost ceiling, directs that certain buildings be vacated, and gives the Act's short title. No outside party (states, public, experts, companies) is consulted or given a role in any federal decision; everything stays within the federal government. There is no real tempting contrary reading, as no hearing, comment, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue appears.
fable.s: There is appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for an additional amount for “Construction of an Extension to the New Senate Office Building” $52,583,400 toward finishing such building

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard appropriations provision that allocates funds for a specific construction project and sets a cost ceiling. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with parties outside the federal government. The actors involved are the Treasury and the Senate, which are internal to the federal government.
qwen_block.s: There is appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for an additional amount for “Construction of an Extension to the New Senate Office Building” $52,583,400 toward finishing such building and to remain available until expended: Provided, That the amount of $137,730,400 shall constitute a ceiling on the total cost for construction of the Extension to the New Senate Office Building.

opus.w: This section only appropriates money, caps total construction cost and requires certain buildings to be vacated once the extension is finished. It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body or right to sue for anyone outside the federal government. The private buildings are named only as space to be vacated, not as parties taking part in a decision.
opus.s: There is appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for an additional amount for “Construction of an Extension to the New Senate Office Building” $52,583,400 toward finishing such building and to remain available until expended
opus.b: This section is an appropriation and cost ceiling for a Senate office building. One reading might be tempting: it names private buildings (the Carroll Arms, the Plaza Hotel and others), so it could look like outside parties are involved. That reading fails. Those buildings are only mentioned as space to be vacated. No one outside the federal government is consulted or coordinated with before a decision, and there is no comment period, hearing, advisory body or right to sue.

qwen_chat.w: This section is an appropriation bill providing funds for the construction of a Senate office building. It does not involve consultation or coordination with any parties outside the federal government (such as the public, states, or private entities). The Senate is part of the federal government, so decisions regarding its facilities are internal government matters. There is no requirement for public comment, hearings, or advisory committees involving non-federal members.
qwen_chat.s: There is appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for an additional amount for “Construction of an Extension to the New Senate Office Building” $52,583,400 toward finishing such building and to remain available until expended: Provided, That the amount of $137,730,400 shall constitute a ceiling on the total cost for construction of the Extension to the New Senate Office Building.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that because the building is for the Senate, and the Senate is part of the government, any decision about it is internal. However, the definition explicitly states that Congress is *inside* the federal government, so interactions with it are not "participation" as defined here. The text is purely an appropriation and a directive regarding the use of space. There is no mention of consulting with the public, states, tribes, or other outside entities. The "needs for personnel" are internal government needs.
